![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The mapping of `inputRows` to `inputRowIds` does not defensively guard against nullish or malformed elements. If `inputPacket.rows` contains a null or non-object element, accessing `row.row_id` will throw a `TypeError` and crash the validation script. We should use a defensive guard check to ignore or safely handle malformed elements.

```javascript
  const inputRowIds = inputRows
    .map((row) => (isObject(row) ? row.row_id : null))
    .filter((rowId) => typeof rowId === 'string');
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When filtering or mapping arrays of objects, use defensive guards (such as checking if the element is a valid object) to ignore nullish or malformed elements instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The validation check directly accesses `contract.source_context.status_model_schema_version` without defensive guards or optional chaining. If `contract` or `contract.source_context` is null or undefined, this will throw a `TypeError` and crash the validation script. We should use optional chaining to handle missing or malformed inputs gracefully.

```suggestion
    contract?.source_context?.status_model_schema_version ===
      'semantic_kg_status_provenance_promotion_model.v1'
      ? passCheck('prior_status_model_loaded', {
        schema_version: contract?.source_context?.status_model_schema_version,
      })
      : failCheck('prior_status_model_loaded', 'status_model_missing_or_wrong_schema', {
        schema_version: contract?.source_context?.status_model_schema_version ?? null,
      }),
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Validation functions should explicitly handle missing, null, or non-object inputs by returning a specific error code (e.g., 'taxonomy_record_required') and failing closed, rather than silently returning empty failures or throwing a TypeError.
</details>
Fixed. `validateShardFixture` now derives `inputRowIds` only from object rows with string `row_id` values, and the new malformed-row regression verifies validation fails closed instead of throwing.
